decisions.statement: An attempt either answers the caller a response or names the account to move to.
A rebind names the account moved to and the credential read for that account.
The response answered is built again from the text the peek read.
Every attempt reaching an account answers in this one shape.
Nothing here reads the status an attempt was made over.
Nothing here chooses the account moved to.

definition: what an attempt to move a request to another account answers with
